whyNotStopTheVm: Company server A's watch.py audits the radio's server-independent backup receipt every 15 minutes; a stopped radio VM makes it RADIO_BACKUP_FAILED_OR_STALE after 26 hours (failure email every day) and suppresses A's own healthy heartbeat, which the absence policy also watches. e2-micro is the Compute Engine free tier (one per billing account in us-central1), so the backup keeps running at no compute cost.
